body:
Review pass 5. $C5 confirmed fixed (legacy_supplied = !missing(whiten) && !is.null(whiten)) - explicit whiten=NULL is now silent. Thanks.

relation_fit VALIDATED AGAINST BASE R - no defects found. This is the change I rated highest-priority in the original review, so I checked it hard:
- residual_df = n - rank exactly (55 for n=60, rank 5)
- effect_covariance == C (Xw^T Xw)^-1 C^T to 1.4e-17 under a nonidentity AR whitener
- residual_block == qr.resid(qr(LX), LY) to 1.4e-15; residuals orthogonal to the whitened design to 1.1e-14
- subset reads == the corresponding columns of a full read to 1.1e-16, forward and reversed order
- capability refusal is exact: no error channel -> all eight capabilities FALSE, and residual_block/effect_covariance/residual_df each refuse naming the missing capability
- rank-deficient design REFUSED with 'Requested effects are not estimable: e1' rather than silently projecting

ONE forward-looking item, $C6 (p2), filed now because Epic 5 is next and this decides its design. residual_block() is not block-plan invariant - reassembling from blocks of 1/2/3/4/6 differs from a single read by 0.5-4 ULP. That is ordinary BLAS non-associativity, not an error. But Epic 5 accumulates residual cross-products in bounded blocks and then INVERTS, so the memory budget perturbs the metric, amplified by conditioning:

  cond(Sigma)=1.68e5:  Sigma drift 1.99e-16  ->  K drift 1.74e-12   (lambda=0)
  lambda=1e-3 (cond 3.46e4) -> 2.41e-13;  lambda=1e-1 (cond 1.77e3) -> 1.58e-15

Amplification tracks cond. Unshrunk local searchlight covariance at k~100, n~200 routinely hits cond>=1e8, which puts K near the default expect_equal tolerance of 1.5e-8. The package already guarantees deterministic execution and carries .canonical_reduce for bitwise-deterministic summation, and the effect-form kernel is feature_block-invariance tested - the metric path has no equivalent guarantee yet. Either reduce residuals canonically, or declare block-plan dependence and put the block plan in the metric recipe signature. Just pick deliberately before writing the accumulator.

$C1 (p0, frame/metric composition + conservation law) and $C2 (K-inverse handle) remain the only unaddressed items. Both gate Epic 2.
